scheme_name: Uttar Pradesh Mukhyamantri Bal Seva Yojana (Genearal)
other_conditions: Children under 18 who have lost one or both parents due to non‑COVID reasons
Adolescents aged 18‑23 who have lost one or both parents due to COVID‑19 or any other reason and are pursuing higher education after 12th grade
Children of divorced or abandoned mothers
Children whose parents or guardian are imprisoned
Children rescued from child labor, begging, or prostitution
Children of families involved in begging or prostitution
Assistance is provided to a maximum of two children per family
Annual family income must be less than ₹3,00,000 unless both parents have died
Institutional children aged 0‑18 who previously lived in children’s homes and have been reintegrated into families or reside in child care institutions
benefits_summary: Eligible children receive a financial assistance of ₹2,500 per month.
